title: Line 69: broad `except Exception` (W0703)
detail: Catching `Exception` broadly at line 69 hides unexpected error types from callers. Fix: catch only the specific exception(s) expected at this site.

title: 1× exception raised without `from` in except block (W0707, first at line 103)
detail: At 1 location(s) (first at line 103), a new exception is raised inside an `except` block without `raise ... from original_exc`. This discards the original traceback and makes debugging harder. Fix: `raise NewExc(...) from exc` to preserve the chain.

title: Builtin `id` shadowed by local variable (W0622)
detail: Local variable(s) at lines 95, 109 shadow the builtin(s) id. If the builtin is needed elsewhere in the same scope, the shadowing causes a confusing `TypeError` or silent misbehavior. Fix: rename the local variable to avoid shadowing.
